why: P278 was the first experiment where the verdict was committed before any independent check; a read-only verifier then found an unimplemented gate clause and a mechanism claim resting on a physically impossible sample. This record makes the two checks that caught it part of the repository, and it is the template for every experiment from P278 forward.

independent_recompute.estimator: from-scratch NCC matcher; deliberately does not import p278_robust_template.py
independent_recompute.note: 1 px occurs where a near-tie between adjacent disparities flips on floating-point summation order; it is inside the pre-registered +-1 px reproduction gate.

perturbation_test.perturbation: disp_recorded += 5 px on every row (breaks the +-1 px gate)
perturbation_test.expected: overall INCONCLUSIVE and every prediction NOT SCORED (pre-registration: no partial credit)
perturbation_test.observed: INCONCLUSIVE / all NOT SCORED / deviation text says FAILED

validity_clauses: disparity < 0 is invalid in rectified stereo with a positive baseline (the Monopoly -18 px sample)
a row with fewer than two usable templates is non-evaluable, not a control (Midd2)
a gate failure short-circuits every other prediction; it never yields a partial score

external_check.by: read-only verification subagent (independent implementation, own temp scripts)
external_check.method: own NCC matcher on 3 rows x 10 positions, perturbed-gate demo, counterfactual deletion of the fallback rule, statistics recomputation
external_check.agreed_on: 30/30 positions at 0 px, verdict reproducible from out/p278/p278_raw.json
found_and_fixed: the reproduction gate was computed but never enforced (now a short-circuit, proven by verify/p278_perturb.py)
P-tmpl-1 PASS depended on an impossible -18 px sample (now PARTIAL, validity-checked)
a tautological control (median == centre) was counted as a win (now non-evaluable)
three wording errors and one unmeasured gloss ('centre lands on background')
